platform: CJSR 88.5 FM Official Digital Album/EP Email and Physical Submission Route
manual_review_reason: CJSR accepts only albums or EPs, not single tracks. Digital servicing must provide downloadable files through a Bandcamp code or durable cloud link rather than Spotify, Tidal or another paid stream; expiring transfer links are discouraged. The package needs clear artist, album and track identification, focus tracks, track lengths, language warnings and tagged audio. CJSR's January 2026 AI policy states it will not air music wholly generated by AI, so a human must verify MarcsMusic's production provenance and eligibility, prepare compliant assets and metadata and send the email or physical package manually.

platform: CFUV 101.9 FM Official Digital Music Department Email Route
manual_review_reason: CFUV requires at least three unique tracks and asks for minimum 320-kbps MP3 files through a digital download link sent to music@cfuv.ca. The submission should include a one-page biography, artist or band name, album title and complete track listing; missing track listings are not considered. Physical servicing is generally limited to artists local to Victoria, Sooke, Duncan or the Gulf Islands. A human must confirm the release contains enough eligible tracks, prepare the download permissions and metadata and send the email manually.

platform: CFRU 93.3 FM Official Digital EP/Album Email Route
manual_review_reason: CFRU's general route accepts EPs or albums with at least three different songs. Artists must email download links to music@cfru.ca and include artist and album information, track listings and contact details; 320-kbps MP3 is preferred. CFRU is digital-only except in rare circumstances. Its separate upload form is restricted to musicians within 50 km of Guelph and is not the MarcsMusic route. A human must prepare the eligible multi-track release, verify link access and metadata and send the general email manually.

platform: CJAM 99.1 FM Official Digital Album Email Route
manual_review_reason: CJAM has moved to digital-only submissions and requires a release with at least four original tracks. Artists must email cjammd@gmail.com with release information and a reliable download link, preferably Dropbox, WeTransfer or Google Drive; direct MP3 attachments and Spotify links are rejected. Audio must be at least 192 kbps in MP3 or AAC, with FLAC also accepted, and files need complete ID tags. A human must verify the four-track threshold, prepare the download package and EPK or concise release context and send manually.

platform: CJSF 90.1 FM National Music Director Form and Music Coordinator Route
manual_review_reason: CJSF provides an official National Music Director submission form and publicly lists cjsfmusc@sfu.ca for music submissions. The form states that submission grants broadcast rights to CJSF and partner campus/community stations, asks the submitter to be an authorized rights holder and offers optional identity and discoverability labels. Singles may enter !earshot Distro but are not considered for CJSF's local library; non-local physical releases are not accepted. Because the embedded form's full live fields, anti-spam controls and any !earshot account or distribution terms are not statically visible, a human must inspect the workflow, approve rights and identity disclosures and submit manually.
